title: FAME: Framework for Allocation with Modular Evaluation
description: Version 1.2.0 of the FAME reproducibility archive. This release preserves the FAME/DOC temporal-transferability and DRR/DRVM post-deployment monitoring research tracks and adds the GPU allocation application, including computational notebooks, decision-oriented calibration, frozen temporal transfer, experimental outputs, and matched-origin comparisons with Native GFS. The external FAME–GFS comparison is distinguished from the incremental contribution of DOC relative to a fixed FAME reference. The matched-origin benchmark is not a causal ablation.
